Question 3
?

Which of the following is equivalent to ∫CF⋅dr, where F(x,y)=2x7i+5x+yj and C is the line segment traversed from the point A(2,3) to the point B(5,4)?

Hint: Use the parametrization r(t)=(2+3t)i+(3+t)j.

a
∫013(2+3t)7+4⋅55+4tdt
b
∫01(2+3t)7+55+4tdt
c
∫016(3t)7+54tdt
d
∫016(2+3t)7+55+4tdt
e
∫014(5+4t)7+3⋅52+3tdt
